notes.subject: קוה … וקוה
notes.rationale: The verse opens and closes with the same verb 'wait/hope on Yawe' — an envelope structure; kept by repeating 'Duw Yawe la'.

notes.subject: imperatives
notes.rationale: Direct second-person summons to the psalmist's own soul and to the hearer: wait, be strong, take courage.

notes.subject: to the psalmist's own soul / to the hearer
notes.rationale: Three imperatives plus jussive addressed to 'your heart'.

notes.subject: קוה
notes.rationale: 'Bind together / collect (by twisting)' — cord imagery — rendered as 'duw' (call on/hope); the twisting picture is lost.

translation: Duw Yawe la; k'i hakɛ to, k'i dusukun kaliya sɔrɔ; duw Yawe la.
